# The Bombae Drip

> Gen-Z streetwear in Seawoods East, Navi Mumbai: boxy shirts, baggy jeans, tees and new drops. Rated 5.0 on Google. Open daily 11 AM–11 PM.

- Hours: Every day 11:00–23:00
